acceptanceCriteria: A reproduction shows which bytes differ between branch and main serializations.
A test or check fails when a committed INDEX.json is not in canonical form.
INDEX.json serialization is identical across generators, or a make target regenerates it deterministically.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. Observed on PRs #513, #516, #517 and #518 on 2026-10-04: merging main into the branch re-escapes docs/specs/INDEX.json entries (spec index), so INDEX.json conflicts need manual keep-both resolution. Suspected, not confirmed: the generator/serializer escaping differs between branches (e.g. HTML escaping or non-ASCII forms) so identical entries differ byte-wise. Reproduce: branch from origin/main, add a spec entry, merge a newer main that also added one, inspect the conflict. Expected: serializer output is canonical and stable so independent entries merge cleanly, or a documented regeneration command resolves the conflict. Actual: whole-entry diffs in INDEX.json. Related: V1-0515, V1-0029.
title: Merging main into a branch re-escapes docs/specs/INDEX.json entries and forces manual keep-both conflict resolution
